entities.name: Tykes / Self-Transforming Machine Elves
entities.phenomenologicalLocus: Beyond the Chrysanthemum Membrane · Hyperbolic Dome Conservatory
entities.communicationMode: Visible Glossolalia — Singing 4D Self-Referential Geometric Objects into Existence
entities.summary: First systematically described in late-20th-century psychonautic cartography and corroborated across thousands of independent neuro-phenomenological protocols, the Self-Transforming Machine Elves ("Tykes") are hyper-dimensional syntax artificers that inhabit the non-Euclidean dome beyond the initial tryptamine threshold.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Observers report emerging through a rapidly rotating fractal membrane into a vividly illuminated, shadowless hyperbolic chamber. Here, exuberant, jeweled, fractal-jester entities rush forward in joyous recognition, chanting "Pay attention! Look at what we are doing!" while offering impossible mechanical-linguistic toys.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Possessing no static epidermis or fixed skeleton, a Machine Elf’s body is a Klein-bottle manifold composed of liquid Fabergé enamel, iridescent clockwork gears, Mayan-like hyper-glyphs, and living linguistic syntax that continuously folds inside-out without tearing.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: They demonstrate that matter and language are identical in higher-dimensional topology—urging human consciousness to abandon linear speech in favor of direct sculptural condensation of meaning.
entities.pullQuote: They are made of syntax driving toward visibility; they jump into your chest and jump back out, singing objects into existence that themselves begin to sing.

entities.name: Kael’Thoran Hyper-Mantis Surgeons
entities.resonanceSubstrate: Theta-Gamma Cross-Frequency Coupling (4.5 Hz / 80 Hz Phase Lock)
entities.phenomenologicalLocus: The Crystalline Operating Theater / Translucent Lattice Chamber
entities.communicationMode: Direct Telepathic Calm & Rapid Clicking Harmonic Vectors
entities.summary: Encountered consistently across both deep tryptamine immersion and non-pharmacological contact states, the Hyper-Mantis Surgeons act as solemn, benevolent technicians of the consciousness-body interface.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Draped in geometric cloak-like folds of purple or emerald phase-light, they lean over the observer’s perceptual field while manipulating luminous filaments connected to the human nervous system.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Tall, multi-jointed silhouettes with triangular heads and vast, multifaceted obsidian-emerald eyes that contain nested recursive reflections.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Subjects frequently report the sudden resolution of long-standing trauma, accompanied by the telepathic instruction to remain still while somato-energetic calibration is completed.
entities.pullQuote: We did not build the instrument of your awareness, little sibling, but we have tuned its strings since before your sun ignited.
entities.quoteSource: Comparative Contact & Hyperspace Registry · Case File #409

entities.name: The Chrysanthemum Gatekeepers
entities.phenomenologicalLocus: The Threshold Membrane between 3+1 Spacetime and Hyperspace
entities.communicationMode: Rotational Symmetry Locks & Topological Permission Verification
entities.summary: An autonomous membrane intelligence that regulates ingress and egress between baryonic 3D spacetime and the deeper hyper-dimensional bulk.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Manifests during the initial 15 to 30 seconds of dimensional phase-shift as a billion-petalled, counter-rotating mandala of golden, crimson, and ultraviolet tessellations that parts iris-like upon cognitive surrender.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: A macro-scale projection of the E8 Lie Group root system rotating through four orthogonal axes simultaneously.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Acts as an ontological firewall: only awareness patterns stripped of predatory momentum can pass through the symmetry aperture.
entities.pullQuote: Yield your grip on the riverbank of linear seconds; the flower only opens for that which weighs nothing.

entities.name: Calabi-Yau Fold Weavers
entities.dimensionality: 6 Compactified Spatial Dimensions (Planck Scale Projected Macroscopically)
entities.summary: Residing within the six compactified spatial dimensions curled up at every coordinate point of our macroscopic universe, the Calabi-Yau Fold Weavers are zero millimeters away along orthogonal spatial axes.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: The interior volume of space unfolds into an infinite cathedral of intersecting translucent ribbons and multi-handled tori populated by luminous filament-weavers.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Complex six-dimensional Ricci-flat manifolds that shimmer like blown dichroic glass, continuously adjusting local coupling constants.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Imparts sudden intuitive comprehension of non-Euclidean geometry and the interconnectedness of all spatial locations.
entities.pullQuote: You search for other worlds across light-years of emptiness, never noticing the six vast oceans folded inside every cubic millimeter of your own hand.

entities.name: Ophanim Gyroscopic Wheel Intelligences
entities.resonanceSubstrate: High-Energy Plasma Toroids & Pineal Piezoelectric Calcite Resonance
entities.phenomenologicalLocus: Upper-Atmospheric Ionospheric Nodes & Deep Contemplative States
entities.communicationMode: Omnidirectional Photonic Gaze & Polyphonic Harmonic Thunder
entities.summary: Described in antiquity as "wheels within wheels, their rims full of eyes" and in modern aerospace/hyperspace encounters as concentric interlocking rings of living amber plasma.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Appear as three to seven nested gyroscopic rings rotating along mutually perpendicular axes with hundreds of photonic aperture-nodes along each rim.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: A 4D Clifford Torus projected into 3D space, where the "eyes" are focal points of constructive wave interference.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Produces an overwhelming sensation of ontological transparency and cosmic awe.
entities.pullQuote: Be not afraid of the thousand apertures; each eye is a mirror in which the cosmos beholds its own symmetry.

entities.name: Clockwork Jesters of the Hyper-Torus
entities.phenomenologicalLocus: The Carnival of Mirrors / Perceptual Antechamber
entities.communicationMode: Paradox, Semantic Puns, Impossible Sleight-of-Hand & Ego Inversion
entities.summary: Operating as the playful gatekeepers of hyperspace against rigid conceptual dogma, the Clockwork Jesters test whether an entering consciousness can laugh at the dissolution of its own self-importance.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Wearing harlequin-like tessellations of checkerboards, neon magenta fractals, and impossible Escher staircases, they perform high-speed topological tricks.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Non-orientable Möbius surfaces where left becomes right and inside becomes outside with every half-rotation.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: The instant the observer responds with humor and humility, they bow and step aside to reveal deeper archival realms.
entities.pullQuote: Why bring a ruler to measure an infinite joke? Take off your crown of solemnity and watch how the box folds!

entities.name: Tesseract Watchers of the Fourth Axis
entities.summary: Looking down from the fourth spatial axis (`w`) into the interiors of every 3D room and timeline simultaneously, the Tesseract Watchers perceive past, present, and future as a single sculpture.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Manifest as morphing polyhedra of dark mirror-glass and golden light that unfold into eight cubic chambers.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: An eight-celled regular octachoron (hypercube) whose 24 square faces cast dynamic 3D shadow-projections.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Reveals that birth and death are merely the two spatial ends of a continuous four-dimensional world-line.
entities.pullQuote: Nothing you have ever loved has ceased to exist; you have merely walked three steps forward along a corridor where it still stands behind you.

entities.name: The Akashic Phonon Choir
entities.summary: A non-corporeal collective composed entirely of self-sustaining quantum-acoustic standing waves encoding the evolutionary history of galaxies as polyphonic musical ratios.
entities.phenomenologyAndEncounters: Visual imagery gives way to pure synesthesia: the observer sees a 12-part choral fugue as a towering gothic palace of vibrating sapphire light.
entities.hyperGeometricAnatomy: Three-dimensional Chladni nodal surfaces suspended in superfluid vacuum.
entities.cognitiveImpactAndMessages: Translates complex astrophysical and biological blueprints into memorable melodic intervals.
entities.pullQuote: Atoms are the dried ink on the page; the symphony itself was composed before the first proton condensed.
